diseases.name: Leaf yellowing (nutrients)
diseases.signs: Older leaves turn pale or yellow all over or between the veins
diseases.treatment: Feed with compost or balanced fertiliser; check drainage and soil pH

diseases.name: Aphids
diseases.signs: Clusters of small soft insects under leaves; curled, sticky leaves
diseases.treatment: Spray soapy water or neem oil; protect ladybirds

diseases.name: Whitefly
diseases.signs: Tiny white insects fly up when leaves are shaken; yellowing
diseases.treatment: Yellow sticky traps; neem oil under leaves weekly

diseases.name: Spider mites
diseases.signs: Fine yellow speckles and thin webbing under leaves
diseases.treatment: Spray water under leaves; neem oil; avoid dusty, dry stress

diseases.name: Thrips
diseases.signs: Silver streaks and tiny black dots on leaves; curled tips
diseases.treatment: Blue sticky traps; neem or spinosad spray

diseases.name: Leaf-eating caterpillars
diseases.signs: Holes chewed in leaves; green droppings
diseases.treatment: Hand-pick; spray Bt (Bacillus thuringiensis)

diseases.name: Leaf miners
diseases.signs: Pale winding tunnels inside the leaf
diseases.treatment: Pick off mined leaves; yellow sticky traps

diseases.name: Flea beetles
diseases.signs: Many small round shot-holes in young leaves
diseases.treatment: Cover seedlings with net; neem; keep weeds down

diseases.name: Mealybugs
diseases.signs: White cottony clumps on stems and leaf joints
diseases.treatment: Wipe off; spray soapy water or neem oil

diseases.name: Scale insects
diseases.signs: Small brown or white bumps stuck to stems and leaves
diseases.treatment: Prune heavy spots; horticultural oil spray

diseases.name: Snails and slugs
diseases.signs: Ragged holes and slime trails, mostly at night
diseases.treatment: Hand-pick at dusk; beer traps; ash barriers

diseases.name: Root-knot nematodes
diseases.signs: Stunted, wilting plants; knots and galls on roots
diseases.treatment: Rotate with cereals or marigold; add compost

diseases.name: Fruit flies
diseases.signs: Small holes in fruit; fruit rots and drops with maggots
diseases.treatment: Bait traps; collect and bury fallen fruit

diseases.name: Powdery mildew
diseases.signs: White powdery coating on top of leaves
diseases.treatment: Remove bad leaves; spray sulphur or milk-water mix

diseases.name: Downy mildew
diseases.signs: Yellow patches on top, grey-purple fuzz underneath
diseases.treatment: Space plants, water at the base; copper spray

diseases.name: Damping-off
diseases.signs: Seedlings collapse at soil level and die
diseases.treatment: Sow in clean, well-drained soil; avoid overwatering

diseases.name: Root rot
diseases.signs: Plant wilts and yellows; roots brown and mushy
diseases.treatment: Improve drainage; do not overwater; remove dead plants

diseases.name: Fusarium wilt
diseases.signs: Leaves yellow on one side, plant wilts; brown inside stem
diseases.treatment: Resistant varieties; rotate 4+ years; remove sick plants

diseases.name: Verticillium wilt
diseases.signs: Yellow V-shaped patches on lower leaves, slow wilt
diseases.treatment: Rotate with cereals; resistant varieties; remove debris

diseases.name: Bacterial wilt
diseases.signs: Sudden wilting of green plant; white ooze from cut stem in water
diseases.treatment: Pull and destroy plants; rotate; resistant varieties

diseases.name: Leaf spot
diseases.signs: Round brown or black spots, sometimes with yellow ring
diseases.treatment: Remove spotted leaves; avoid wet leaves; copper spray

diseases.name: Cercospora leaf spot
diseases.signs: Small round grey spots with a dark red-brown border
diseases.treatment: Rotate crops; remove debris; copper or mancozeb

diseases.name: Alternaria leaf spot
diseases.signs: Dark brown spots with target-like rings
diseases.treatment: Remove old leaves; rotate; mancozeb if severe

diseases.name: Anthracnose
diseases.signs: Sunken dark spots on leaves, stems or fruit
diseases.treatment: Clean seed; prune for airflow; copper spray

diseases.name: Rust
diseases.signs: Orange or brown powdery bumps under leaves
diseases.treatment: Remove infected leaves; space plants; sulphur spray

diseases.name: Grey mould (Botrytis)
diseases.signs: Soft brown rot covered with grey fuzzy mould
diseases.treatment: Improve airflow; remove rotting parts; avoid wet leaves

diseases.name: White mould (Sclerotinia)
diseases.signs: Soft rot with white cottony growth and black seed-like bodies
diseases.treatment: Rotate away from beans/brassicas; wide spacing

diseases.name: Bacterial soft rot
diseases.signs: Slimy, smelly rot of stems, heads or roots
diseases.treatment: Avoid wounds; dry storage; remove rotting plants

diseases.name: Bacterial leaf spot
diseases.signs: Small water-soaked spots that turn dark; leaf edges die
diseases.treatment: Clean seed; copper spray; avoid overhead watering

diseases.name: Mosaic virus
diseases.signs: Light and dark green mottled, crinkled leaves; stunted growth
diseases.treatment: Pull sick plants; control aphids; use clean seed

diseases.name: Leaf curl virus
diseases.signs: Leaves curl upward, thicken and yellow; plant stunted
diseases.treatment: Control whitefly; remove sick plants; resistant varieties

diseases.name: Early blight
diseases.signs: Brown target-ring spots on older leaves first
diseases.treatment: Remove lower leaves; mulch; mancozeb or copper

diseases.name: Late blight
diseases.signs: Dark water-soaked patches, white mould under leaf in damp weather
diseases.treatment: Destroy infected plants fast; copper or mancozeb before rain

diseases.name: Septoria leaf spot
diseases.signs: Many small grey spots with dark edges on lower leaves
diseases.treatment: Remove lower leaves; mulch; copper spray

diseases.name: Blossom-end rot
diseases.signs: Black sunken patch at the bottom of the fruit
diseases.treatment: Water evenly; add calcium (lime or gypsum)

diseases.name: Black rot
diseases.signs: Yellow V-shaped patches from leaf edge; black veins
diseases.treatment: Clean or hot-water seed; rotate 3 years

diseases.name: Clubroot
diseases.signs: Plants wilt on hot days; swollen club-shaped roots
diseases.treatment: Lime soil to pH 7.2; rotate away from brassicas

diseases.name: Diamondback moth
diseases.signs: Small holes and see-through windows in leaves
diseases.treatment: Bt spray; intercrop; remove crop debris

diseases.name: Cabbage worms
diseases.signs: Large ragged holes in leaves; green caterpillars
diseases.treatment: Hand-pick; Bt spray; insect net

diseases.name: Tipburn
diseases.signs: Leaf edges inside the head turn brown and dry
diseases.treatment: Water evenly; avoid too much nitrogen

diseases.name: Bolting (early flowering)
diseases.signs: Plant shoots up a flower stalk; leaves turn bitter
diseases.treatment: Sow in cooler season; keep soil moist; harvest early

diseases.name: Purple blotch
diseases.signs: Purple spots with yellow halo on onion leaves
diseases.treatment: Rotate; good spacing; mancozeb spray

diseases.name: Onion thrips
diseases.signs: Silvery-white streaks on leaves; leaf tips dry
diseases.treatment: Overhead watering washes them off; neem

diseases.name: Neck rot
diseases.signs: Bulbs soften at the neck in storage; grey mould
diseases.treatment: Dry bulbs well before storage; avoid late nitrogen

diseases.name: White rot
diseases.signs: Yellow, dying leaves; white fluffy mould on bulb base
diseases.treatment: Rotate 8+ years; do not move infected soil

diseases.name: Carrot fly
diseases.signs: Rusty tunnels in roots; leaves turn reddish
diseases.treatment: Cover with fine net; sow later in season

diseases.name: Cavity spot
diseases.signs: Small sunken pits on the root surface
diseases.treatment: Lime acid soil; avoid waterlogging

diseases.name: Gummy stem blight
diseases.signs: Brown leaf spots; cracked stems that ooze gum
diseases.treatment: Clean seed; rotate; remove vines after harvest

diseases.name: Cucumber beetles
diseases.signs: Yellow-black beetles chewing leaves and flowers
diseases.treatment: Row covers until flowering; hand-pick

diseases.name: Squash bugs
diseases.signs: Grey-brown bugs; leaves wilt and turn black
diseases.treatment: Hand-pick eggs and bugs; clear debris

diseases.name: Cucumber mosaic virus
diseases.signs: Mottled yellow-green leaves; warty fruit
diseases.treatment: Control aphids; pull sick plants

diseases.name: Angular leaf spot
diseases.signs: Angular brown spots bounded by leaf veins
diseases.treatment: Clean seed; rotate 2 years; copper spray

diseases.name: Bean rust
diseases.signs: Reddish-brown powdery bumps with yellow ring
diseases.treatment: Resistant varieties; sulphur spray

diseases.name: Bean common mosaic
diseases.signs: Mottled, puckered, downward-curled leaves
diseases.treatment: Clean certified seed; control aphids

diseases.name: Bean stem maggot
diseases.signs: Seedlings wilt; stem base swollen and cracked
diseases.treatment: Early sowing; seed dressing; earth up stems

diseases.name: Pod borer
diseases.signs: Holes in pods and flowers; caterpillars inside
diseases.treatment: Hand-pick; neem or Bt at flowering

diseases.name: Storage weevils (bruchids)
diseases.signs: Round holes in stored seeds
diseases.treatment: Dry seeds well; store in airtight bags

diseases.name: Ascochyta blight
diseases.signs: Brown spots with dark rings on leaves and pods
diseases.treatment: Clean seed; rotate; remove debris

diseases.name: Northern leaf blight
diseases.signs: Long cigar-shaped grey-brown lesions on leaves
diseases.treatment: Resistant hybrids; rotate; bury residue

diseases.name: Grey leaf spot
diseases.signs: Narrow rectangular grey lesions between veins
diseases.treatment: Rotate with legumes; tolerant hybrids

diseases.name: Fall armyworm
diseases.signs: Ragged holes in young leaves; sawdust-like droppings in the whorl
diseases.treatment: Scout weekly; ash or sand in whorl; Bt or spinosad

diseases.name: Stem borer
diseases.signs: Holes in leaves in rows; dead heart; tunnels in stem
diseases.treatment: Push-pull with desmodium; destroy stalks after harvest

diseases.name: Smut
diseases.signs: Black powdery masses replacing grain or swellings
diseases.treatment: Clean or treated seed; remove smut galls early

diseases.name: Rice blast
diseases.signs: Diamond-shaped grey spots with brown edge on leaves
diseases.treatment: Resistant varieties; balanced nitrogen; avoid drought

diseases.name: Maize lethal necrosis
diseases.signs: Yellow mottle from leaf base; leaves dry from the edges
diseases.treatment: Certified seed; rotate; rogue sick plants

diseases.name: Striga (witchweed)
diseases.signs: Pink-flowered weed attached to roots; crop stunted
diseases.treatment: Rotate with legumes; push-pull; hand-pull before seeding

diseases.name: Ergot
diseases.signs: Sticky honeydew then dark hard bodies in grain heads
diseases.treatment: Clean seed; deep ploughing; remove grass hosts

diseases.name: Bird damage
diseases.signs: Grain heads pecked empty
diseases.treatment: Scare tapes; timely harvest; netting

diseases.name: Cassava mosaic disease
diseases.signs: Yellow-green mosaic, twisted narrow leaves
diseases.treatment: Plant clean cuttings; resistant varieties; rogue early

diseases.name: Cassava brown streak
diseases.signs: Yellow blotches along veins; brown rot in roots
diseases.treatment: Clean cuttings; tolerant varieties; harvest early

diseases.name: Cassava green mite
diseases.signs: Yellow speckled, small, deformed young leaves
diseases.treatment: Release predatory mites; clean cuttings

diseases.name: Sweet potato weevil
diseases.signs: Tunnels in roots; bitter smell
diseases.treatment: Plant clean vines; earth up cracks; rotate

diseases.name: Sweet potato virus disease
diseases.signs: Small, crinkled, pale leaves; poor yield
diseases.treatment: Use clean vines; remove sick plants

diseases.name: Yam anthracnose
diseases.signs: Black spots on leaves; shoots die back
diseases.treatment: Clean seed yams; resistant varieties

diseases.name: Taro leaf blight
diseases.signs: Purple-brown water-soaked spots on leaves
diseases.treatment: Resistant varieties; remove sick leaves; copper

diseases.name: Common scab
diseases.signs: Rough corky patches on tuber skin
diseases.treatment: Keep soil moist at tuber set; avoid fresh manure

diseases.name: Potato tuber moth
diseases.signs: Tunnels in tubers; mined leaves
diseases.treatment: Hill up well; store tubers covered

diseases.name: Banana Xanthomonas wilt
diseases.signs: Leaves yellow and wilt; yellow ooze from cut stems
diseases.treatment: Remove male bud; clean tools; uproot sick mats

diseases.name: Panama disease (Fusarium)
diseases.signs: Older leaves yellow and collapse around trunk
diseases.treatment: Resistant varieties; clean suckers; do not move soil

diseases.name: Black Sigatoka
diseases.signs: Dark streaks that join into large black dead patches
diseases.treatment: Remove infected leaves; good drainage; fungicide

diseases.name: Banana weevil
diseases.signs: Tunnels in corm; plants topple
diseases.treatment: Clean suckers; trap with split stems

diseases.name: Banana bunchy top
diseases.signs: Narrow upright leaves bunched at top; dark green streaks
diseases.treatment: Destroy sick plants; clean suckers; control aphids

diseases.name: Citrus greening (HLB)
diseases.signs: Blotchy yellow leaves; small lopsided bitter fruit
diseases.treatment: Remove sick trees; control psyllids; clean seedlings

diseases.name: Citrus canker
diseases.signs: Raised corky spots with yellow halo on leaves and fruit
diseases.treatment: Prune sick twigs; copper spray; windbreaks

diseases.name: Gummosis
diseases.signs: Gum oozing from bark; bark cracks
diseases.treatment: Improve drainage; scrape and paint with copper paste

diseases.name: Scab
diseases.signs: Rough olive-brown scabby spots on leaves and fruit
diseases.treatment: Rake fallen leaves; prune; sulphur or copper spray

diseases.name: Fire blight
diseases.signs: Shoots blacken and bend like a shepherd's crook
diseases.treatment: Prune 30 cm below damage; sterilise tools

diseases.name: Brown rot
diseases.signs: Fruit rots brown with grey-buff powdery spores
diseases.treatment: Remove mummified fruit; prune for airflow

diseases.name: Peach leaf curl
diseases.signs: Red, puckered, curled leaves in spring
diseases.treatment: Copper spray at leaf fall and bud swell

diseases.name: Codling moth
diseases.signs: Holes in fruit with brown droppings at the core
diseases.treatment: Pheromone traps; bag fruit; collect fallen fruit

diseases.name: Mango hoppers
diseases.signs: Flowers dry up; sticky honeydew and sooty mould
diseases.treatment: Prune dense canopy; neem at flowering

diseases.name: Sooty mould
diseases.signs: Black soot-like coating on leaves
diseases.treatment: Control the sap-sucking insects causing it; wash leaves

diseases.name: Phytophthora root and collar rot
diseases.signs: Wilting, yellowing tree; dark rot at stem base
diseases.treatment: Improve drainage; avoid deep planting; phosphonate

diseases.name: Black pod
diseases.signs: Brown-black rot spreading over pods
diseases.treatment: Remove sick pods weekly; prune for shade and airflow

diseases.name: Coffee leaf rust
diseases.signs: Yellow-orange powder under leaves; leaves drop
diseases.treatment: Resistant varieties; shade management; copper spray

diseases.name: Coffee berry disease
diseases.signs: Dark sunken spots on green berries
diseases.treatment: Prune; copper spray during rains; resistant varieties

diseases.name: Coffee berry borer
diseases.signs: Small round hole at berry tip
diseases.treatment: Pick all ripe and fallen berries; traps

diseases.name: Blister blight (tea)
diseases.signs: Pale translucent blisters on young leaves
diseases.treatment: Prune; shade control; copper spray

diseases.name: Red rot (sugarcane)
diseases.signs: Leaves dry; split cane shows red with white bands
diseases.treatment: Clean setts; resistant varieties

diseases.name: Bollworm
diseases.signs: Holes in buds, flowers and bolls
diseases.treatment: Scout; Bt or neem; destroy crop residue

diseases.name: Leafhoppers (jassids)
diseases.signs: Leaf edges yellow then burn and curl downward
diseases.treatment: Resistant varieties; neem spray

diseases.name: Tobacco mosaic virus
diseases.signs: Light-dark green mosaic; distorted leaves
diseases.treatment: Wash hands; no smoking near plants; remove sick plants

diseases.name: Groundnut rosette
diseases.signs: Stunted bushy plants with yellow mottled leaves
diseases.treatment: Plant early and dense; control aphids

diseases.name: Early and late leaf spot
diseases.signs: Dark round spots on leaves; heavy leaf drop
diseases.treatment: Rotate; remove volunteers; fungicide if severe

diseases.name: Aflatoxin mould
diseases.signs: Yellow-green mould on pods or kernels
diseases.treatment: Harvest on time; dry fast; store dry

diseases.name: Fruit anthracnose
diseases.signs: Sunken round spots with rings on ripe fruit
diseases.treatment: Clean seed; pick fruit promptly; copper

diseases.name: Phytophthora blight
diseases.signs: Sudden wilt; dark stem lesions at soil line
diseases.treatment: Raised beds; drainage; avoid flooding

diseases.name: Lettuce mosaic virus
diseases.signs: Mottled, puckered leaves; heads fail to form
diseases.treatment: Virus-free seed; control aphids

diseases.name: Fusarium root rot
diseases.signs: Brown lesions on roots and lower stem; yellowing
diseases.treatment: Rotate; drainage; avoid compacted soil

diseases.name: Asparagus beetle
diseases.signs: Chewed spears and ferns; grey grubs
diseases.treatment: Hand-pick; clear old ferns in winter

diseases.name: Crown rot
diseases.signs: Plant base rots; plant collapses
diseases.treatment: Plant high; good drainage; do not bury crown

diseases.name: Root rot (Pythium)
diseases.signs: Wilting and browning in wet soil
diseases.treatment: Well-drained mix; water only when topsoil dry

diseases.name: Mint rust
diseases.signs: Orange pustules on stems and under leaves
diseases.treatment: Cut down and burn infected stems; thin plants

diseases.name: Basil downy mildew
diseases.signs: Yellowing leaves with dark fuzz underneath
diseases.treatment: Space plants; morning watering; resistant varieties

diseases.name: Leaf blight
diseases.signs: Brown patches on leaf tips that spread
diseases.treatment: Remove sick leaves; avoid overhead watering

diseases.name: Strawberry leaf spot
diseases.signs: Small purple spots with white centres
diseases.treatment: Remove old leaves; renew beds every 3 years

diseases.name: Mites on trees
diseases.signs: Leaves bronze and drop in dry weather
diseases.treatment: Spray water; predatory mites; avoid dust

diseases.name: Stem borers (trees)
diseases.signs: Holes in trunk with sawdust; branches die
diseases.treatment: Cut out damaged wood; seal wounds

diseases.name: Termites
diseases.signs: Plants wilt; mud tunnels on stems; roots eaten
diseases.treatment: Remove dead wood; neem cake; keep plants healthy

diseases.name: Storage rot
diseases.signs: Produce rots in storage
diseases.treatment: Cure and dry well; store cool and ventilated

diseases.name: Fruit rot
diseases.signs: Soft brown rot on ripening fruit
diseases.treatment: Pick on time; remove rotten fruit; airflow

diseases.name: Palm leaf spot
diseases.signs: Brown spots on fronds; fronds dry early
diseases.treatment: Remove old fronds; balanced potash

diseases.name: Rhinoceros beetle
diseases.signs: V-shaped cuts in new fronds
diseases.treatment: Remove breeding sites (rotting logs); traps

diseases.name: Bud rot
diseases.signs: Spear leaf rots; foul smell; palm dies
diseases.treatment: Remove infected tissue; copper paste

diseases.name: Sunscald
diseases.signs: Pale papery patches on fruit facing the sun
diseases.treatment: Keep leaf cover; shade cloth in heat

diseases.name: Fruit cracking
diseases.signs: Fruits split after heavy rain or watering
diseases.treatment: Water evenly; mulch

diseases.name: Grasshoppers and locusts
diseases.signs: Large bites taken from leaf edges
diseases.treatment: Hand-catch early; neem; plough to expose eggs

diseases.name: Weevils
diseases.signs: Notched leaf edges; grubs in roots or stems
diseases.treatment: Hand-pick at night; clean planting material

diseases.name: Ant-tended aphids
diseases.signs: Ants running up stems farming aphids
diseases.treatment: Sticky band on stems; control aphids

diseases.name: Cabbage root fly
diseases.signs: Plants wilt; white maggots on roots
diseases.treatment: Collars around stems; fine net

diseases.name: Leaf beetles
diseases.signs: Small holes and skeletonised leaves
diseases.treatment: Hand-pick; neem spray
